output.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_discount_2025
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND discount_amount > 0;
output.explanation: Counts all 2025 orders regardless of status whose order-level discount_amount (gross_amount minus net_revenue) is greater than zero, which means at least one line carried a discount. The filter on order_date limits the set to calendar 2025, and no is_revenue filter is applied because the question includes every status.
